name: Landscapers
summary: Inspired by real events, Landscapers explores the lives of convicted killers Susan and Christopher Edwards, and asks how this devoted and mild-mannered couple came to kill Susan's parents and bury them in the back garden of their Mansfield home, in a crime that remained undiscovered for over a decade. This blackly comic, narratively playful true crime drama is based on extensive research, hours of interviews and direct access to the accused, who have always protested their innocence of murder.

name: Industry
summary: Industry follows a group of young graduates competing for a limited set of permanent positions at a top investment bank in London—but the boundaries between colleague, friend, lover, and enemy soon blur as they immerse themselves in a company culture defined as much by sex, drugs, and ego as it is by deals and dividends. As members of the group rise and fall, they must decide whether life is about more than the bottom line.

name: My Bromance
summary:
A young woman's life suddenly becomes extremely troublesome: she gets fired by her evil boss, her roommate is an care-free (but smart) internet personality, her brother crashes at her place after being dumped by his boyfriend and to top it all off, her mother announces she's getting a divorce and moves in with all of them.
The hot guy who keeps buying her coffee at the coffee shop is suddenly the least of her worries.

Still, even more trouble starts brewing on the horizon when her roommate's best friend comes by. It turns out he's hopelessly in love with her brother.

name: Somewhere Only We Know
summary: Ph.D. candidate in Physics Mu Cheng He catches a third-year student in English Xue Tong cheating on an exam. When he even becomes the substitute teacher in her elective course Russian and makes her study with him after classes, her hatred for him only grows. Over time, however, Xue Tong discovers Teacher Mu's true character and comes to secretly love him.

name: I Started Following Romance
summary: Five university students use Instagram to explore their romantic feelings for one another. They learn to express their most heartfelt emotions via the social networking app's features--making inventive use of comments, likes, direct messages, hashtags, and stories. At the heart of the story is a campus couple In Byuel and Dong Hoon, as well as the ever-cheerful, ever-charming Seul Ki. Will the students' mastery of Instagram help them all achieve their love goals?

name: A Life on Screen
summary: Series that celebrates the incredible careers of the best of British talent.

name: Dragons' Den: On Tour
summary: The Dragons tour the UK to find out what happened next to their investments.

name: Dragons' Den: Where Are They Now?
summary: Series catching up with contestants from Dragons' Den.

name: Dragons' Den: Outside the Den
summary: Series revealing the lives of the Dragons' Den Dragons.

name: Rental Reviews
summary: Come on down to Cinemassacre Video, where selection is the name of the game. We've got comedy, drama, action, horror, movies for kids, movies for mom and dad, we've got the newest releases, the hottest video games, even Laserdisc. Having a problem making a selection? Our friendly staff is always there to help out, and with our state of the art database software, it's easy to find exactly what you're looking for, even if it sucks. Cinemassacre Video, in the Voorhees Memorial Shopping Center next to Caldor.

previousepisode.name: Rental Reviews Episode 100 - Crazy VHS Tape Cover Art

name: Zemheri
summary: Firuze and Ayaz. Fate brought them together. Her father's unjust conviction in the elevator accident that killed thirteen people triggered Firuze. Carrying the responsibility of being the man of the house, Ayaz is faced with Firuze, which he sacrificed for his mother when he was about to marry another.

name: Reverse Engineering
summary: One dish. Two days. A challenge for super taster Chris Morocco to blindly taste a dish made by a famous chef and then reverse engineer it as closely to the original as he can.

previousepisode.name: Recreating Frida Kahlo's Oaxacan Black Mole From Taste

name: Back to Back Chef
summary: In each episode, a celebrity chef challenges an amateur to keep up with him or her as they make a dish in 15 minutes, with one big caveat: The amateur can't see the chef—they can only listen.

previousepisode.name: Troye Sivan Tries to Keep Up With a Professional Chef

name: Luwak Human
summary: Jung Cha Shik is a man in his 50s. He graduated from high school and now works as a salesman. His job is to import coffee beans, but he gets into trouble and causes damage to the company. He faces forced retirement because of what happened. A miracle then happens Jung Cha Shik. Overnight, he becomes "Luwak Human.".

name: Airport 24/7: Thailand
summary: Behind the scenes at one of South East Asia's busiest hubs.

name: Romesh's Look Back to the Future
summary: Romesh Ranganathan, Richard Osman, Katherine Ryan and Danny Dyer made big predictions for 2018. Now they confront their hologram selves to see if they came true.

name: Liberi tutti
summary: A corrupted lawyer sentenced to house arrest is forced to go to live in the cohousing building run by his ex-wife and has to learn and deal with a world totally different from his own.

name: Killer Inside: The Mind of Aaron Hernandez
summary: Killer Inside: The Mind of Aaron Hernandez examines what led to the murderous fall and shocking death of former NFL superstar Aaron Hernandez.

name: Code Lyoko: Évolution
summary: Code Lyoko: Évolution is the sequel to the French animated television series Code Lyoko. Set one year after the events of the original series, Jeremy Belpois, Odd Della Robbia, Ulrich Stern, William Dunbar, Yumi Ishiyama and Aelita Schaeffer return to their daily lives and routines at Kadic Academy. XANA, despite their success in defeating it previously, suddenly reappears, reborn with even more strength and power than ever before. The protagonists resume their former double lives in order to protect humanity from XANA's evil schemes once again. Joined by William Dunbar, who has finally been accepted as the sixth Lyoko warrior, and an unreliable girl-genius named Laura Gauthier, the seven heroes are bent on unraveling the reasons for such a return and to exterminate the malevolently evil sentient, autonomous artificial intelligence/multi-agent system that is threatening the world once again.

name: Fragile
summary: Fragile tells the story, in reverse, of two diametrically opposite families: the wealthy, influential Bachands and the middle-class, salt-of-the-earth Coutures. It's also the story of an unlikely friendship between Dominic Couture and Félix Bachand. The pair's mysterious death sends a shock wave through their families, exposing jealously guarded secrets, dangerous liaisons and hidden agendas.

name: The Age of A.I.
summary: We are at the dawn of a new age and the implications of AI technology for humans are almost unimaginable. Welcome to The Age of AI. Discover the most innovative and leading technologies that will change the world forever. Technology is moving faster than ever, and it's taking less time to be widely adopted. Join host Robert Downey Jr. to explore the depths of this fascinating, gripping technology.

previousepisode.name: How A.I. is Searching for Aliens

name: Realm of the Volga
summary: With a stunning variety of landscapes and species, the Volga flows ver 2,000 miles, traversing the heartlands of Russia.

name: Les liaisons dangereuses
summary: Updated adaptation of Choderlos de Laclos' classic 18th Century tale of seduction, betrayal and revenge set in the modern 1960s world of Parisian high society. The beautiful Madame de Merteuil seeks vengeance against her ex-lover Gercourt when he becomes engaged to her young goddaughter, Cécile. Merteuil turns to her ex-lover/partner-in-crime, Valmont, famous for his reputation as a Don Juan, to seduce Cécile and emotionally destroy her. While on his mission, Valmont gets sidetracked when he goes to visit his aunt and falls for Madame Tourvel, a virtuous, married woman who knows of his womanizing ways, but that only makes the challenge more exciting to Valmont. Together, Madame de Merteuil and Valmont make a dangerous team and they will stop at nothing when it comes to matters of the heart.

name: Rent Controlled
summary: When the love of her life breaks up with her the day after they move in together, Heather has to decide if she should move on, move out, or put on the moves that would win back Jennifer's heart.

name: What We Were Watching
summary: Join Grace Dent on a televisual trip back in time.

name: 90 Day Fiancé: Just Landed
summary: In 90 Day Fiancé: Just Landed, three Americans wait for each of their fiancés to arrive from overseas. They wait for the most critical 24 hours of their relationships, which starts once the planes land.

name: Scissor Seven
summary: On a small island, Seven, an assassin who can disguise himself as anything, carries out various assassinations at a low price, charging only 567 yuan for each mission.

name: The Testaments
summary: The Testaments is based on Margaret Atwood's Booker Prize-winning novel of the same name, which was published in 2019 and takes place in the dystopian theocracy of Gilead. Years after the events of The Handmaid's Tale, The Testaments is a coming of age story that finds a new generation of young women in Gilead grappling with the bleak future that awaits them. For these young women, growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known, having no tangible memories of the outside world prior to their indoctrination into this life. Facing the prospect of being married off and living a life of servitude, they will be forced to search for allies, both new and old, to help in their fight for freedom and the life they deserve.

name: Agent
summary: A former footballer tries to make it as a player agent in the world of African soccer, but a secret from his past threatens to destroy everything.

name: Cosmic Disclosure
summary: There are those who believe it is not humanity's destiny to wither away within the clutches of Earth's cycles of life and extinction. Rather we are to venture forth, beyond our terrestrial origins and establish thriving civilizations throughout the cosmos. Some have already secretly realized this vision, while others are relegated to technology dependent upon dwindling resources. A conflict now rages whether to preserve these advancements for the ranks of the elite, or to share this destiny with the whole of humanity and usher in a new era of peaceful conscious advancement.

previousepisode.name: The Floating Continent of Genis Zeus 8

name: The Greek Islands with Julia Bradbury
summary:
In The Greek Islands with Julia Bradbury, the presenter uncovers the hidden side of well-known islands like Corfu, Crete and Santorini as well as uncovering some lesser-known island gems like Symi, Thirassia and Skopelos, location for global smash Mamma Mia, island-hopping her way to her ultimate destination, Chios - the island of her heritage.

She goes off the well-trodden tourist track to discover secret beaches, exquisite coves and unspoilt countryside, immersing herself in the islands' age-old traditions and sampling some of the best food and drink they have to offer to provide a vivid and surprising insight into some of our most popular holiday destinations.

name: Welcome to HMP Belmarsh with Ross Kemp
summary:
This series goes inside the walls of HMP Belmarsh with Ross Kemp to offer a sharp insight into the harsh realities of life behind bars at arguably the country's most notorious jail.

With cameras gaining full access to the prison in South East London for the first time, Ross went inside the jail over a period of six months to find out what life is like inside the maximum security lock-up that has housed the country's most dangerous - and infamous - convicts.

Cameras follow Ross as he explores how prisoners and staff cope with high-profile inmates, extremists and common criminals living side-by-side, goes inside the High Security Unit – the only ‘prison within a prison' in England and Wales - experiences the effect drugs can have on prisoners, and gets an insight into Belmarsh's efforts to rehabilitate inmates.

He also sees how this complex prison operates as a violent protest unfolds outside, gaining a full-access close insight into life for staff and prisoners while it goes into lockdown.

name: Jamtara - Sabka Number Ayega
summary: A group of small-town young men run a lucrative phishing operation, until a corrupt politician wants in on their scheme -- and a cop wants to fight it.

name: Prise au piège
summary: Anne Rivière, wrongly accused of the murder of a computer scientist in her company, finds herself immersed in the prison world. She will have to fight for her survival in the face of violence, while her father and brother will do everything to prove her innocence.

name: Les Touristes
summary: Arthur has invited six celebrities, Upon their arrival, they will experience a somewhat special tourist stay and discover a surprising universe where they have never set foot!

name: Dreaming Back to the Qing Dynasty
summary: Ming Wei has the ability to travel through time to the Qing dynasty, under Kang Xi's reign. She catches the attention of the princes and gets entangled in a romance with the 13th prince.

name: Itaewon Class
summary: Itaewon Class tells the story of Park Sae Roy who is uncompromising in the face of injustice as he goes up against the food industry conglomerate in Itaewon. Meanwhile, Jo Yi Seo is a highly intelligent sociopath with the face of an angel but a completely different personality. Finally, Oh Soo Ah is an honest and confident woman who was Park Sae Roy's first love and is now an employee of a rival company.

name: The Game: Towards Zero
summary:
The Game: Towards Zero tells the story of a prophet and a detective who partner up in order to solve a serial murder case.

Kim Tae Pyung is a prophet who can foresee anyone's death just by looking into their eyes. This changes when he meets Joon Young whose death he cannot see. Joon Young is a detective who works at Yongsan Police Station. She partners with a prophet to solve a mysterious murder case. Meanwhile, Goo Do Kyung is a forensic expert. He is a perfectionist who digs through every case.

name: Meet the Street at Christmas
summary: Renowned choirmaster Mark De-Lisser has four weeks to assemble four choirs of strangers, bringing them together for performances of their lifetimes in front of family and friends.

name: Zorro
summary: Don Diego de la Vega opposes the corrupt tyrants of Spanish California as the masked swordsman, Zorro.

name: Freshman Dorm
summary: Drama student Molly heads to Western Pacific to be with boyfriend athlete Danny who soon is her ex. Her dorm mates include KC who struggles financially, wealthy Lulu, slacker dude Zack, Joe the hunk and bookish Alex.

name: Bureau Burgwallen
summary: Ewout Genemans closely follows the officers of Bureau Burgwallen. From the station, in the patrol car, and after intense arrests or confrontations, he captures every moment. Never before has the image of police officers in the Netherlands been documented so closely.

name: Demon's Path
summary: Three murderers believed that they would be able to escape justice by keeping a low profile over time. However, as a new case appears, their respective unsolved crimes are being reinvestigated through the efforts of a new team of police officers comprising a gifted pathologist, a workaholic detective and a pair of siblings. To continue covering up for their crimes, the murderers work together in this battle between good and evil.

name: Zentrix
summary: One day in Zentrix, an ambitious and powerful robot, named OmicronPsy, plots with several other robots to rebel against humans, attempting to absolutely annihilate the civilization of human beings and crown themselves the only inhabitants of the world. In response, Megan, the princess of Zentrix, teams with a number of humans and together travel back to the past, hoping to destroy OmicronPsy before his rebellion has begun.

name: The Paranormal Action Squad
summary: The Paranormal Action Squad is an animated adult comedy show from YouTube Red starring the YouTubers SeaNanners, Mr. Sark, and VanossGaming; while YouTubers TheSyndicateProject and H2O Delirious appear in guest starring roles.

name: Cold Case Detective
summary: Cold Case Detective dives into some of the most mysterious unsolved cases of our time.

previousepisode.name: Under the Smoking Towers: The Disappearance Sneha Anne Philip

name: Yes Boss
summary: Meera and Mohan Srivastava are married and working in the same office. They have not disclosed their relationship to their boss Vinod Verma, who does not miss any chance of flirting with Meera. Mohan hates it and spends most of his time protecting his wife from Mr. Verma.

name: G-Senjou no Anata to Watashi
summary: Yaeko Kogure is a 27-year-old OL. She informs her company that she will resign to get married. Her fiance then informs her that he is in love with another woman and he breaks off their engagement. Yaeko Kogure now doesn't have a job or a boyfriend. While crying, she hears "Air on the G String" playing live in a shopping mall. The song inspires her to enroll in a violin class for adults. There, she meets university student Rihito Kase and housewife Yukie Kitagawa. Yaeko Kogure becomes attracted to Rihito Kase.

previousepisode.name: Even If We Can't Meet Again

name: Still Lala
summary: Everything is going great for Du La La. Now in her 30s, the insecurities of her younger years are behind her. She is happily married to Wang Wei and is the HR manager at work and about to face a promotion to become the HR director. But La La's complacent life is challenged when a new employee shows up in the form of Kathy, a beautiful woman in her 20s whose professional star shines brighter than La La's.

name: Itai no wa Iya nano de Bōgyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu.
summary: Honjou Kaede is invited by her friend Shiramine Risa to play a virtual reality MMO game with her. While Kaede doesn't dislike games, what she really, truly dislikes is being in pain. She creates a character named Maple, and decides to put all her points in VIT to minimize pain. As a result, she moves slowly, can't use magic, and even a rabbit can get the best of her. But as it turns out, she acquires a skill known as "Absolute Defense" as a result of her pumping points into VIT, as well as a "Counter Skill" that works against special moves. Now, with her ability to nullify all damage, she goes on adventures.

previousepisode.name: Maxing Defense and the Big Final Battle

name: Love Journey
summary: A white-collar worker and a detective become embroiled in an elaborate mystery when a famous painting gets linked to an international drug smuggling enterprise.
Sitcom about Julie and Jesper on how life treats you at the age of 29.

name: Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story
summary:
* Based on a smartphone role-playing game.

In exchange for the fulfillment of a wish, Magical Girls keep fighting, unbeknownst to the rest of the world. But Tamaki Iroha can't seem to remember her wish.

"When I became a Magical Girl, what did I wish for again?"

There is a gaping hole in her life. Something important has been lost. But she continues to fight every day, without even knowing why... Then, a rumor begins to spread among Magical Girls.

"Magical Girls can be saved if they go to Kamihama."

Kamihama City, the city where Magical Girls and Uwasa are gathering. The story of Tamaki Iroha, in search of her lost wish, begins...

name: Carrie
summary: Based on Stephen King's iconic debut novel, Carrie is a bold, timely, and surprising reinvention of this classic coming of age story, adapted for television for the first time by visionary showrunner Mike Flanagan. Misfit high schooler Carrie White has spent her life hidden away inside the walls of her home with her fiercely protective mother, Margaret. After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence. Told over eight propulsive episodes, the series expands King's cultural landmark - deepening its characters and tensions, and following the small, everyday choices that build toward a single, shattering night, in a gripping, deeply human story about kindness versus cruelty, and whether we're witnessing the making of a hero, a monster, or something far more complicated.

name: DAVE
summary: DAVE is centered on a neurotic man in his late twenties who has convinced himself that he's destined to be one of the best rappers of all time. Now he must convince his closest friends, because with their help, he actually might convince the world.

name: La Famille Blaireau-Renard
summary: The Badger family's life is very quiet until Mrs. Fox and her daughter Rosie move in. The lively Mrs. Fox brings joy back into Mr. Badger's life but for the children it means having to accept a new sibling. Ultimately, they learn to get along: all's well that ends well, The Mr. Badger & Mrs. Fox book series has been translated into fourteen languages, touching on living together in a blended family, celebrating differences, and emotion recognition.

name: 2Wish
summary: The story of Two and Wish who live together after graduated. Wish is waiting for a job so he's responsible for housework. Two got an office work and meet a lot of people incluiding a net idol "Auy" who come to interfere their relationship.

name: Ming Dynasty
summary:
Sun Ruo Wei entire family is killed on the orders of the Yongle Emperor in 1402, though she escapes death after being secretly adopted by Sun Zhong. Sun Ruo Wei becomes the concubine of crown prince Zhu Zhan Ji by chance, and continues to investigate the truth behind her family's death.

However, Sun Ruo Wei decides to abandon her revenge plans after realising how dangerous it would be to destabilise the court for her own personal goals. Touched by Zhu Zhan Ji's kindness, Sun Ruo Wei resolves to become a virtuous empress who can support him in times of hardship. Unfortunately Zhu Zhan Ji passes away after a decade on the throne, and Sun Ruowei is honoured as Empress Dowager once her 7 year old Zhu Qi Zhen ascends the throne.

name: Ratman to the Rescue
summary: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung Sing has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung Sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi Yan, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan Ngai, Hoi Yan becomes a private investigator. Leung Sing is forced to help Hoi Yan with her investigation activities as Hoi Yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk Kei. Gold digger Tong Mei Fun is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun Wai and she become foes. Mei Fun forgives Tsun Wai and offers to help him as Tsun Wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung Sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi Yan shockingly finds out Kwan Ngai's real character. Leung Sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi Yan.

name: Nee Sanaeha
summary: Rin is the illegitimate daughter and sole heir of a wealthy man. Akanee is the adopted son of Rin's father and his legal wife. One day, Rin's father brings her into the family and she clashes with her step mother while developing feelings for Akanee. But there's more secrets to unravel.

name: Si Thep Poo Pitak
summary: Four guardian Gods join forces to protect the world, with the power of 4 magical items. You have the Earth God, the Wind God, the Water God and the Fire God who is cursed to come to the human world

name: Anti-Fraud League
summary:
The first drama to tell a story from the point of view of insurance investigators and their efforts to fight fraud.

It revolves around a team comprised of yuppy Fang Yuan, genius boy Mi Ruo, the animated Luo Xin and social butterfly Niu Meng. They run an insurance investigation agency which tackles all sorts of insurance cases.

name: Parallel Tokyo
summary: A fictional story about news team at a TV station in Tokyo struggling after an earthquake.

name: Who Kissed Me?
summary: The concept of "Kiss Scene in Yeonnam-dong" is 'who kissed her that night?' and it's about a young woman who has been single all her life looking for the most handsome kisser. She has been single all her life, but she's not all that innocent in this honest romantic story of young people.

previousepisode.name: I feel like I'm gonna die when you're nice to me

name: Die Buddenbrooks
summary: Family saga set in 19th century Germany, chronicling the lives of three generations of the Buddenbrook family, the owners of a family business in the northern town of Luebeck. Based on the novel by Thomas Mann.

name: Breaking the News
summary: Topical comedy panel show takes a satirical view of the week's headlines.

name: Ghost Adventures: Screaming Room
summary: Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Jay Wasley and Billy Tolley gather in their screening room and get candid about their most iconic investigations, including Branson's Titanic Museum, Goatman's Bridge in Texas, the unforgettable Island of the Dolls and more. Away from the haunted locations we usually see them in, with no equipment or investigations, it's just the team, some munchies and never-before-heard stories from the moments that created a legacy.

name: Tony Robinson's History of Britain
summary: Tony Robinson explores the history of the nation through the everyday lives of ordinary people.

name: Die Pfefferkörner
summary: Following the lives of five teenage friends who fight against crime and injustice from their headquarters in a Hamburg warehouse.

name: Self-Made Mansions
summary: Along with a local realtor, lifestyle expert Clinton Kelly finds three potential properties to help self-made entrepreneurs and creative geniuses find the home of their dreams after striking it rich.

name: Nevernight
summary: In a land where three suns almost never set, a fledgling killer joins a school of assassins, seeking vengeance against the powers who destroyed her family.

name: This is Not a Business Expense
summary: Sanako Moriwaka is single and works in the accounting department of a soap company. For her job, she checks receipts and bills. Each slip that she reviews, mentions only the dollar amount and a brief reason for the expense. When Sanako Moriwaka reviews the slips, she can often discern suspicious facts surrounding the expense or even troubles in the lives of the employee.

name: The Comedians at the King's
summary: Stand-up comedy from Glasgow's King's Theatre.

name: Neues aus Büttenwarder
summary: The farmers Kurt Brakelmann and Arthur Adsche Tönnsen are the two stars of this series from Germany's far north, which combines the idyll of the Plateland with the natural humor of its residents. Kurt and Adsche have known each other for ages and are already trying to outdo each other again and again. But when storm clouds rise over the home of Büttenwarder and problems arise, the two stick together like bad luck and sulfur and mostly every situation with wit and peasant cunning. And at sunset Kurt and Adsche sit with stable boy Kuno and Mayor Schönbiehl in Wirt Shorty's village mug and start the day's events with the local house drink "Lütt un Lütt".

name: Eizouken ni wa Te wo Dasu na!
summary: Asakusa Midori wants to create an anime, but she's too disheartened to make that first step by herself. By pure chance, she meets Mizusaki Tsubame, an up-and-coming socialite secretly dreaming of becoming an animator. Together with Midori's money-loving best friend Kanamori Sayaka, the energetic trio slowly work towards making their "ultimate world" a reality!

name: Housekishou Richard-shi no Nazo Kantei
summary: The novel follows Richard Ranashinha Dvorpian, a handsome British jewelry appraiser, and Seigi Nakata, a bright and upright Japanese college student. The duo solves various jewel-related cases by unraveling the hidden psychological aspects of their owners that lie within the gems.

name: Lost Home Movies of Nazi Germany
summary: The two-part series Lost Home Movies of Nazi Germany delves into the private collections of Germans, both civilian and military, who recorded the dawn of an empire that they thought would last a thousand years. These rolls of film reveal a different side of Hitler's Third Reich— both at home during peacetime and on the front lines of the war. It is a candid look at what life was really like for those living in, and under Hitler's Swastika - at home - and abroad, a record not only of what they saw, but of what they knew.

name: Oshi ga Budoukan Ittekuretara Shinu
summary: A girl is obsessed with her favorite idol, a minor member of a less popular group, enough that she says she'd die to see her play at Budoukan.

previousepisode.name: If My Favorite Pop Idol Made It to the Budokan

name: Rikei ga Koi ni Ochita no de Shoumei shitemita.
summary: Yukimura Shinya and Himuro Ayame are two scientists that want to find out if love can be solved by a scientific theory. These two scientists also have feelings for each other and want to be able to solve their feelings through similar theoretical facts. With this perfect opportunity, these scientists will attempt to solve the theory of the love they express for each other.

previousepisode.name: I Tried to Prove that You Are Fine Just as You Are

name: Runway de Waratte
summary:
Runway de Waratte starts with the story of Fujito Chiyuki, an aspiring fashion model and daughter of a fledgling Modeling Agency, Mille Neige. Ever since she was little, Chiyuki's dream was to be the star model of her dad's agency and perform at Paris Fashion Week. With great looks and a gifted environment, it seemed like she was on the right track to fulfill her dream, but she soon found herself faced with a seemingly insurmountable wall when her height stopped growing at 158 cm; too short to be a professional model.

Although Chiyuki still kept on believing in herself for years despite everyone telling her it's impossible, Chiyuki's resolve starts to crumble as she enters her last year of high school. This is when she meets Tsumura Ikuto, a lame classmate with a surprising talent for designing clothes, who is also considering giving up his dream due to unfortunate circumstances. Together, they begin the journey of doing the impossible in order to realize their dreams.

name: Somali to Mori no Kamisama
summary:
The world is ruled by spirits, goblins, and all manner of strange creatures. Human beings are persecuted, to the very point of extinction. One day, a golem and a lone human girl meet.

This is a record of the pair, one a member of a ruined race, the other a watchman of the forest. It tells of their travels together and of the bond between father and daughter.

name: 1000-lb Sisters
summary: Tipping the scales at over 1,000 pounds combined, the Slaton sisters try to lose enough weight to qualify for and undergo life-changing bariatric surgery and pursue their dreams.

previousepisode.name: Amy Was Afraid, She Was Petrified

name: Chyłka
summary: Joanna Chylka is capable, uncompromising, courageous and rebellious. In a legal world full of men, they do not give in to anything. When three-year-old Nikola Szlezyngier disappears without a trace, and the police do not find evidence of kidnapping, the main suspects become the child's parents. It is Chylka and her new apprentice Kordian Orynski who undertake to defend the marriage. All circumstantial evidence, however, indicates the blame of the Szlezyngers. Will lawyers manage to bring the case together to a happy final?

name: Natsunagu!
summary: Natsuna Kunugi, a university student in Tokyo, visits Kumamoto in search of friends who she could not contact following the Kumamoto earthquakes. There, she meets local people who are full of compassion and uniqueness, including the energetic junior high school student, Izumi. A heartfelt coming-of-age story begins.

name: Омар в большом городе
summary: The story of a young man from the Dagestan village of Novolakskoye, whose parents tried to marry a girl from a very good family. To avoid a wedding, the guy comes up with the idea that he works at Gazprom and leaves for Moscow. At the station, Omar meets the taxi driver Oleg, and from that moment his adventures in the big city begin.

name: Atrapa A Un Ladrón
summary: Juan Robles, a top thief who was nicknamed "the Cat", put an end to his criminal activities. When hold-ups are committed while respecting the same M.O. as his, Juan is suspected by Inspector Lola Garay of being the author. But the policewoman is Juan's fiancée.

previousepisode.name: No habrá más pena ni olvido

name: Programa da Maisa
summary: Programa da Maisa is a SBT talk show hosted by one of Brazil's favorite stars, Maisa Silva. It premiered in 2019 with great ratings and it continues to this day. Maisa is known for being a child star in Brazil, starting her career at a very young age in talent shows.

name: БУМ
summary: Ukrainian adaptation of Wipeout.

name: NFL: The Grind
summary: A weekly destination for the final word on the week in football, as well as an up close and personal, inside look at life in the NFL--on and off the field--across the endurance test that is the NFL season.

previousepisode.name: Week 17: How it Started, How it's Going

name: Eden
summary: In the very distant future, the human race has disappeared. Or so they thought ... In the mechanical metropolis Eden 3 only robots live. One day, two farmer robots run into a human baby in the city and make a decision that will change everything.

name: Unchained
summary:
A devout Rabbi-detective tasked with unchaining women whose husbands deny them of a Jewish divorce and a new life, finds out that in his own home, and his own wife, lurks a secret that threatens his world and marriage.

Through the story of Yossef Mourad and his wife Hannah, Unchained takes the viewer into the closed-off world of the ultra-orthodox Haredi society, and touches on the most painful place in which Jewish-law clashes with modern life – the status of women in society.

name: Tell Me What You Saw
summary: An eccentric genius profiler, Oh Hyun Jae who works with a detective with photographic memory, Cha Soo Young and a police chief, Hwang Hwa Young to go after a serial killer who was thought to be dead.

name: Britain's Favourite...
summary: Celebrities give their verdicts on the countdown to some of Britain's most loved things.

name: Not Quite End of the Year Show
summary: The countdown to The Bells begins as Amy Irons looks back with special guests and music.

name: Baantjer het Begin
summary: Detective Judd Cox has just been promoted to the toughest department within the capital cities' police force.

name: Зелёный фургон
summary:
The original continuation of the popular two-part detective-adventure television film "The Green Van" (1983), which was set in Soviet Odessa in the 1920s.

1946 year. After 20 years, all in the same Odessa, matured Volodya Patrikeev continues to fight crime. After serving in prison in 1937, having won in the penal battalion, and then in reconnaissance, he returns to civilian life and begins to investigate complex criminal cases under the direction of a completely "green" sergeant Zhenya Krasavin ... Their first, insignificant, investigation of surrogate vodka that flooded the city, leads detectives to the very top, to Moscow. And, if they do not stop the criminals, the biggest geopolitical scandal could break out ...

name: Lost in the Wild
summary: Journalist Kinga Philipps and filmmaker J.J. Kelley investigate the most-fascinating missing person cases on the planet. At each harrowing location, the intrepid explorers speak to locals, witnesses and experts in hard-hitting interrogations. They follow the evidence trail no matter where it goes, putting themselves in heart-pounding situations that test their limits.

name: Allt jag inte minns
summary: A young man dies in a car crash and his mother's world collapses. When she finds out that it may not have been an accident, she becomes obsessed with finding out the truth: why did her 25-year-old son die?

name: Die Snobs – Sie können auch ohne dich
Your Imagination Becomes Reality
summary: A "will-they-won't they" relationship of a person who hasn't dated in 20 years Your imagination becomes reality?? Even in a beginning-of-the-semester party?? There's always a person who ruins the atmosphere in college beginning-of-the-semester parties. But there is also campus romances (Please)! Will Soram's imagination finally become reality.

name: 1 Jaar Gratis
summary: A tough waste course disguised as a fun quiz with a group of candidates, each episode of which someone is sent home until one winner remains. The winner will receive the net annual salary of the highest-earning participant.

name: Genera+ion
summary: Genera+ion follows a group of high school students whose exploration of modern sexuality (devices and all) tests deeply entrenched beliefs about life, love and the nature of family in their conservative community.

name: My Mate's a Bad Date
summary: Sex and relationship guru Oloni dishes out a cold, hard dose of reality to seven disastrous daters, to show them where it's all going wrong.

name: Checker Tobi
summary: Spin-off of Checker Can. Knowledge magazine for children and adolescents, in which reporter Tobias Krell in compact and funny reports Tobi cheekily asks, tries everything and has the courage to embarrass himself.

name: Marie fängt Feuer
summary: A fire brigade suddenly ended Marie and her fiance's hen party. The wedding then falls into the water. The young woman realizes that the volunteer fire department is doing very badly. She wants to change that.

name: Chopped Sweets
summary: In a sweet spinoff of the ultimate culinary competition, host Scott Conant challenges four bold pastry artists to take on one of the toughest tests of their lives. Faced with baffling basket ingredients and an unrelenting clock, the sensational, sugar-savvy chefs must demonstrate their skill, concentration and imagination as they race to see who will claim the $10,000 prize.

name: Landkrimi
summary: The crime lurks in each of the Austrian provinces: the series of the ORF takes place in a different region of the country in each episode and is cast with other actors, but the thrillers are united by the strong regional connection.

name: Justin Bieber: Seasons
summary: Chronicling the making of Justin Bieber's first album in four years, Justin Bieber: Seasons is a raw, powerful and intimate look at Bieber's process of creating new music and the motivation for this new album told through the lens of his closest confidants, friends, collaborators and Bieber himself. The series will also feature a behind-the-scenes look at Bieber's private life, including never-before-seen footage of his wedding to Hailey Bieber and his day-to-day alongside those in his inner circle. With brand new music scoring the episodes, Justin reflects on the highs and lows of growing up in the public eye as he invites his fans on the journey leading up to the release of the highly-anticipated and most personal album of his career.

name: My Engineer
summary: When Bon the popular engineering student starts a revenge plan on Duen, the innocent first year medical student, their feelings slowly start to grow through roses that Duen has to buy for Bon every day for a month. The series bring out the different side of each couple and their journey with friends and their relationship.

name: Nisman: El fiscal, la presidenta y el espía
summary: This docuseries details the suspicious death of Alberto Nisman, investigator of the 1994 bombing of the Argentine Israelite Mutual Association building.

name: Else om: selvmord
summary: In 2016, over 600 people took their own life in Norway, but we do not hear much about these deaths. Else Kåss Furuseth wants do something about this. Her goal is to create a series about suicide that makes you want to live. Do you need someone to talk to? Call Mental Helse: +47 116 123.

name: MBC Drama Awards
summary: MBC Drama Awards is an annual award show of Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation (MBC) where actors and staff are awarded for their work. The grand prize of winning the best series title of the year is done by public voting.

name: KBS Drama Awards
summary: KBS Drama Awards is an awards ceremony hosted by KBS for excellent achievements for Korean series aired on it's network. The most honoured price is the ''grand prize'' which will be awarded to the best actor or actress of that year.

name: SBS Drama Awards
summary: SBS Drama Awards is an award show hosted by Seoul Broadcasting System (SBS) and is annually held on the last day of the year at the SBS Prism Tower. The most honoured price of SBS will be gifted to an actor or actress for a single role he played in a Korean drama that aired on their network.

name: Datoen
summary: Three people born on the same day. Three lives that take different directions and are merged by small and large events in history that connect all about us.

name: Amnesia
summary: An amnesiac might be a key figure in Detective Mackenzie Stone's search for his own wife, who disappeared on their fifth wedding anniversary three months prior.

name: Angels of Jarm
summary: The angels--Ellie, Mick and Rafe--live in a silver bullet caravan above a cloud with their leader, Gabrielle. Each Angel is of a different faith, but they all live in harmony and know exactly what to do to prevent conflict in the Jarm playgroup.

name: Стендап Андеграунд
summary: A new comedy show in the genre of Stand-Up comedy. Each episode, 6 comedians will tell monologues prepared over many months, in which their experiences and observations are revealed. All authors are united by courage in choosing topics, freshness and relevance in their view of familiar things.

name: Le 422
summary: 422 rue Sauvé has been abandoned for years. The owners are said to have gone in search of their missing daughter and never returned. That doesn't stop Lou and his friends from making it their hideout, despite the mysterious door with 100 padlocks in the basement. What is it for ? Is it to protect us or - to protect what is hidden there?

name: New Eden
summary: Spanning the 70s, 80s, and 90s over eight half-hour episodes, New Eden is a hilariously complex, true crime parody that begins in 1977, when Katherine Wryfield and Grace Lee attempt to start a large scale feminist utopia, "New Eden." While intentions for this would-be utopia were noble, in the inexperienced hands of Lee and Wryfield, the community quickly devolves into drug addled, alien-goddess worshipping chaos… and murder. Definitely some murder.

name: Yanxi Palace: Princess Adventures
summary: A determined Qing dynasty princess contends with palace intrigue and a vendetta against her family while navigating the treacherous terrain of romance.

name: Женский стендап
summary: There are no forbidden topics for the heroines of "Female Stand-up". They honestly talk about what they are not satisfied with in a relationship, ridicule the stereotypes of family life and frankly declare that it is actually very difficult to be a good mother.

name: Konchû monogatari minashigo Hutch
summary: Raised since his birth by his aunt, the little Hutchi will learn one day that he is actually the son of the queen of bees, who disappeared shortly before giving birth. The orphaned Prince then sets out to find his mother, wherever she is, and goes on an adventure. He will take notice of a hostile and dangerous environment and face many joys and sorrows, and face a thousand dangers while discovering the life around him.

name: Killer Bods
summary: A body can be a temple, but temples can be desecrated. A bodybuilder's flawless physique could spark murderous jealousy, insecurity or rage in others. Egos powerful enough to sculpt chiseled biceps and washboard abs are certainly strong enough to plot murder. Killer Bods chronicles the actual murder cases surrounding America's fitness revolution. Each story has more twists and turns than a Pilates class. Never has true crime looked so stunning at first glance, but so dark just below the surface.

name: Velkommen til Utmark
summary: In a small remote Norwegian town live: a corrupt sheriff, an alcoholic shepherd, a nature-loving bootlegger, a God-hating pastor and a grieving pimp.

name: Livstid
summary: Livstid follows investigator Victoria Woll and her colleagues. The series opens with an older Woll in her 60s serving a long prison sentence, with each episode then following Woll in the past as her team solves a crime, slowly revealing how she ended up behind bars.

name: Holidaying with Jane McDonald
summary: The singer, with the help of a rotating cast of famous guests, travels the globe to sample dream holidays.

name: Castelo Rá-Tim-Bum
summary: Castelo Rá-Tim-Bum is a kids TV show that shows the adventures of Nino, a boy that lives in a castle with his uncle Dr. Victor and his aunt, the witch Morgana. Nino's friend's, Pedro, Biba and Zequinha are always curious to find out about the oddities of the castle.

name: Državni službenik
summary: This is a modern and exciting story about BIA agents in Belgrade who eliminate the most dangerous threats to Serbia behind the eyes of the public on a daily basis and lead the struggle in the labyrinth of domestic and foreign intrigues, the circumstances of the contemporary geopolitical situation.

name: Skam VSG
summary: Parody of Julie Andem's Skam set in Villa San Giovanni.

name: Meat the Family
summary: Four families challenge their meat-eating habits by caring for farm animals in their homes. At the end of three weeks, they must decide whether to save their house guests and send them to a sanctuary or reintroduce them to the food chain - and face the prospect of the animals becoming their dinner.

name: Red Arrows Take America
summary:
Series following the famous squadron as they head to North America for one of their most ambitious foreign tours, performing in front of millions across the United States and Canada, as they fly over iconic landmarks including New York City, Niagara Falls and the Golden Gate Bridge.

The trip has been planned in meticulous detail for over a year, but each leg still comes with serious risks and difficulties, from bad weather to major technical problems.

name: Please Love Me
summary: A popular idol and a manicurist fall into a romance with an expiration date when they have to pretend to be married.

previousepisode.name: Who Invited Her to the Party?!

name: Asteroid in Love
summary: When she was little, Mira Kinohata met a boy named Ao at a campsite in town. While gazing at the starry sky together, Mira learns that there's a star with the same name as herself, but no star named Ao. The two then promised to one day explore asteroids together and find a star to name it after him. Several years later, Mira enrolls at the Hoshizaki high school and decides to join the astronomy club to fulfill her promise. However, she learns that the astronomy club will be merged with the geological research society to form the earth science club. Reluctantly, Mira goes to the club room and is reunited with Ao Manaka—the person she made the promise to explore asteroids with—and is shocked to learn that she is a girl!

name: Angel Beside Me
summary: Lin is a poor girl who is on the verge of suicide when suddenly been interrupted by a loud crash through the ceiling of her room. An angel known as Michael Lansaladon fell from heaven after observing Lin's attempt suicide. As a blessed angel in heaven, he understood human's feelings. Feelings such as taste, excitement, fatigue, anger, pain, and love.

name: Infidels
summary: The lives of five young sexy women in Barcelona. Close friends whose professional lives, friendships, love, passion and sense of humor make up a series of stories that evolve around self-assurance and loyalty to one's principles.

previousepisode.name: Me'n vaig a casa, a escriure un bolero.

name: Sherlock: Untold Stories
summary: Set in present-day Tokyo, Homare Shishio works as a freelancer crime consultant. From an early age, Shishio has been fascinated with how people become criminals and in original sin. He is a genius, but he also has an impulse to commit crimes. Shishio works on cases that interests him among police or customer requests.

name: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.: Reawakened
summary: Kusuo and his gaggle of self-proclaimed friends are back for more psychic mishaps. If he didn't have enough problems before, he's got even more now.

name: Maysa: Quando Fala o Coração
summary: A woman who follows her heart in every single step of her life, breaking paradigms, following her dreams and becoming one of the greatest Brazilian singers.

previousepisode.name: Mãe e filho fazem as pazes

name: Presença de Anita
summary: A mid-aged and troublesome man finds inspiration for his newest romance in a lonely, mysterious and seductive nymphet.

name: Polityka
summary: Portraying the events that have taken place in Polish politics in recent years. A 4 episode TV mini-series based on a movie with the same title.

name: Hairy Bikers' Mississippi Adventure
summary: In this ultimate food and music pilgrimage, the perennially popular Hairy Bikers are getting back in the saddle as they explore the length of the iconic Mississippi river in America in pursuit of the delicious roots of soul food and Southern music.

name: 100 Day Dream Home
summary: Brian and Mika Kleinschmidt are a husband-and-wife team from Tampa, Florida, that makes dream homes come true. She's the realtor, he's the developer and together they help clients both design and build the perfect house from the ground up in 100 days or less.

name: H2O: Mermaid Adventures
summary: Three high school friends who turn into mermaids whenever they touch water have undersea adventures while keeping their new life a secret.

name: Une Île
summary: Chloé is a young woman who does not mingle much with other young people on the island. She was found in a cave as a child and suffers due to the fact that she never knew her parents. She is dragged along to a party on the beach, where a boy who forces a kiss from her falls into an extended state of unconsciousness. Two fishermen disappear at sea. In the hull of their boat, we discover Théa, a splendid woman, strange and calmly confident in her powers of seduction. Bruno, a cop brought over from the mainland for the occasion understands her. She has come looking for Chloé. A relationship of animality/humanity will play out between the two women, and love will become a danger, both to men and to them.
In this animation series, the audience will witness the secrets behind the group's debut and the story leading up to their creation via the different viewpoints of each member.

name: Song by Song
summary: You know your favorite singers' songs, but do you know about the songs and how they help tell each singer's life story? You will if your favorite singer is profiled on Song by Song, the series that showcases songs from each featured singer and how the songs provide insight into each artist's life and career. The series also features interviews with other singers and celebrities who talk about the singer's impact on them and on pop culture.

name: Crime Farm
summary: Crime Farm is a psychosexual love story that follows Selma and Richard Eikelenboom, forensic homicide experts whose marriage thrives on their all-consuming investigations into the depravity of the world's most notorious criminals. As a seminal case upends the paradigm of their relationship, their unique, unconventional and sometimes dangerous arrangement stretches the boundaries of marriage and science.

name: S.O.Z. Soldados o Zombies
summary: To avoid extradition, the charismatic and unpredictable drug lord Alonso Marroquin escapes from a Mexican prison to hide in a remote facility located in the middle of the desert. On the U.S. side of the border a U.S. Army experiment with minipigs conducted in a military base goes wrong and the Mexican police unit pursuing Marroquin gets infected, transforming themselves into a new enhanced zombie species with special abilities. The army and this new species converge on Marroquin's hideout where battle for survival will begin.

name: The Sex Factor
summary: The Sex Factor is a web-based reality porn show in search of the next top porn stars. The series follows sixteen wannabe porn stars (eight guys and eight girls) who have never been filmed before. They're not "amateurs," they're actual civilians who responded to an open casting call. The contestants compete in increasingly explicit challenges to win their share of a $1M prize along with instant porn superstardom.

name: When Darkness Calls
summary: The Central Illinois Ghost Hunters (C.I.G.H) set out to capture and prove the existence of the paranormal while helping families and businesses with their experiences.

name: The Cursed
summary: Reporter Jin Hee reports only about what she believes to be right, but she's pulled deep when see covers a violent case involving Forest, one of South Korea's biggest IT company. She bumps into So Jin who is possessed by a spirit and has a special ability, when she investigates into an affiliated company as Jin Jong Hyun, chairman of Forest, relies heavily on shamanism.

name: Hi bye, Mama!
summary: When the ghost of a woman gains a second chance at life for 49 days, she reappears in front of her remarried husband and young daughter.

previousepisode.name: Petals Fall, But the Flower Endures

name: Hyena
summary: Yoon Hee Jae and Jung Geum Ja are lawyers who work for the top 1% in society. Jung Geum Ja is a lawyer, who is after money only. She wins her cases using any means necessary. Yoon Hee Jae is an elite lawyer, who is smart and confident at his job.

name: Nobody Knows
summary: Cha Young Jin is a detective. She lost her friend 19 years ago to a serial killer and still carries guilt and trauma over the death of her friend. The serial killer case then begins again after 19 years. Cha Young Jin chases after the killer.

name: 22. juli
summary: They help the injured. They comfort the bereaved. They try to understand. This is the story of those who were at work when the terror hit Norway on July 22, 2011.

name: Sherlock Uncovered
summary: Sherlock Uncovered goes behind-the-scenes of television's most famous detective series, looking at the evolution of Sherlock and revealing production secrets.

name: Adventurous Romance
summary:
A love story about chasing your dreams also touches upon the dark side of using brain implants to control one's emotions. A once famous idol and his fangirl meet again. Their lives hang by a thread after being caught in the middle of a conspiracy.

Because of false rumors about him, singer Liu Xing Yu was forced to retire from the industry despite his passion for music. He assumes a new name as Xin Yu and starts a new life on campus where he crosses paths with Qian Shi Yan who was once his most loyal fan. After a series of events, a chilling experiment involving brain control comes to light. Will Xing Yu succeed in overcoming his inner demons to reach his dreams?

name: Oddbods
summary: Seven unusual characters laugh, fool and trip their way through life.

name: Babil
summary: The series explores the life of Irfan, an idealistic professor who is upset by his unfair dismissal and is trying to care for his sick son. As the doors close one by one, Irfan finds himself in the middle of a dark adventure that he can't escape.

name: The Outlaws
summary:
The Outlaws follows seven strangers from different walks of life forced together to complete a Community Payback sentence in Bristol.

At first, they seem like archetypes we can easily pigeonhole, but gradually we see behind their façades, understand their hidden depths, and what made them the people they are today. We are reminded that no one is all good or all bad. Everyone has a story.

As their unlikely new friendships intersect with their complicated private lives, The Outlaws must unite to protect one of their own from Bristol's most dangerous criminal gang.

name: Истории про Фину
summary:
An example of the best Russian animation of a new wave. The project "Antimult" became known first in the Russian Internet (www.antimult.ru), and then in the world. Anti-cartoons were shown by the Russian NTV channel and some European television channels. In the episodes of cartoons, people appear who look like BG, Putin, Ernst, Clinton, Lagutenko, Zhirinovsky, Schwarzenegger, Kramarov, Kuleshov, Pavlovsky and cars similar to Citroen SZ and Bentley Continental GT.

The plot of these 18 cartoons: The owner of the Moscow advertising agency, the beautiful businesswoman Fina, and her employees: designer Pasha, professor Lev Davydovich and cleaning lady Klavdia Nikitichna find themselves in funny, sad, instructive situations.

name: Big 12 Championship Game
summary: The Big 12 Championship Game is a college football game held by the Big 12 Conference. The game was played each year since the conference's formation in 1996 until 2010 and returned during the 2017 season. From 1996 to 2010 the championship game pitted the Big 12 North Division champion against the South Division champion in a game held after the regular season was completed. From 2017 onward, the game features the two teams with the best conference records

previousepisode.name: 2025 Big 12 Championship Game: BYU Cougars vs. Texas Tech Red Raiders

name: Born Mucky: Life on the Farm
summary: Series capturing the reality of life for modern British farmers, exploring the resilience and commitment required to keep farms thriving.

name: Raise de wa Chanto Shimasu
summary: In the Next Life I Will Be Serious follows the sexual lives of five people, including Momoe Omori, who work at CG production company Studio Delta. Momoe Omori is 27-years-old and single. She has intimate relationships with five male friends. She thinks of physical intimacy as a hobby that doesn't cost money.

name: Crackerjack!
summary: Children's entertainment show presented by Sam and Mark, featuring comedy sketches, variety acts and games including Double or Drop, Stickly Come Dancing and Splatterjack.

name: Panda Judges the World
summary: Miss Panda is a mysterious woman with extraordinary physical ability. She has a male keeper who manages her. Miss Panda and her keeper receive a request from Mr. No Compliance. Miss Panda and her keeper attempt to reveal a hidden truth, which the police and media will not deal with.

name: Off the Record
summary: Keito is a reporter for a weekly magazine. The magazine covers everything from corruption by politicians to entertainers' scandals. She watches out for the next big scoop. Keito is also rich and enjoys her work, as well as her love life. One day, Keito's mother suddenly dies. Anna was a single mother who raised Keito alone. She worked as a movie critic. Right before her death, Anna mentioned something about Keito's father. The name she mentioned is that of a Hollywood star.

name: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
summary: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa embraces the wild side of the Sunshine State. With a stellar zoo team devoted to the exotic cast of animals, this dedicated team cares for both their lovable zoo family as well as rescues and rehabs animals in need, including orphaned black bear cubs, injured panthers, manatees, otters and alligators.

name: Come Together! to the Seton Academy
summary: Seton Academy, a school full of animals where, thanks to population decline, there are fewer humans than any other creature. Mazama Jin, an animal hater and the only human male in his class, falls in love with Hino Hitomi, the only female human, the moment he lays eyes her. However he soon finds himself entangled with various other creatures after he reluctantly joins the 'pack' of Lanka the wolf, the only other member of her pack.

name: Heartland Docs, DVM
summary: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

name: Matchday: Inside FC Barcelona
summary: FC Barcelona and Rakuten present Matchday, a new documentary series in which viewers will get to enjoy exclusive never-seen-before footage of Ernesto Valverde's squad. For the first time ever, TV cameras were allowed to film the everyday lives of players such as Leo Messi, Gerard Piqué, Marc-André ter Stegen and Luis Suárez, offering a more intimate portrait of them both during competition and in their personal lives. Inside FC Barcelona follows the famed football club through its 2018-2019 season.

name: Veganville
summary: A group of dedicated vegans move to a town in Wales to try to introduce as many people as possible to their vegan way of life.

name: Cornwall: This Fishing Life
summary: As Brexit brings new hope, can a new generation of fishermen save their traditional way of life?

name: True Life Crime
summary: Take a deep dive into the true-crime stories rocking headlines and social media feeds. These victims were young, the crimes against them were shocking and haunting questions remain.

name: Friends Speak
summary: Friends Speak is a dramatic new factual series from the unique perspective of those who were friends with notorious criminals or their victims, featuring first-hand accounts of the days leading up to, and the days following, the crimes.

name: Me & My 10 Kids: Mega Families
summary: Documentary following the hectic lives of two British families wrestling with the struggles and joys of raising 10 kids apiece.

name: Murder Trial
summary: Murder, mystery, and a search for justice. A compelling insight into the work of the police and prosecutors bringing suspects to trial at Glasgow's High Court.

name: Stewart Copeland's Adventures in Music
summary: Stewart Copeland travels the world meeting composers, musicians, film-makers, DJs and scientists to ask the question, 'How does music work?'

name: Wheeler Dealers: Dream Car
summary: Mike Brewer is taking on his toughest challenge yet, as he turns his attention to people who lack the know-how or resources to get their dream motor. Each episode sees Mike and his trusted mechanic Marc ‘Elvis' Priestley meet a new client and find inventive ways to add value to their existing vehicle, before flipping it for a profit and reinvesting the proceeds in a series of trade-ups that result in a dream car.

name: the goop lab
summary: Leading with curiosity and keeping it real, Gwyneth Paltrow and her goop team look at psychedelics, energy work and other challenging wellness topics.

name: Tutunamayanlar
summary: Tarik, who has never worked in his life, falls in love with Irem in a job interview. Having no place to go, Irem comes to the neighborhood where Tarik lives and starts to work at the book cafe in the neighborhood. Irem's dream is to be successful, to establish her own business and to return to her old days one day.

name: Dolls' Frontline
summary: Re-imagines famous firearms as moe girls with machine bodies that are known as T-Dolls.

name: Bone Detectives: Britain's Buried Secrets
summary: Tori Herridge and a team of scientists piece together the lives behind unearthed bones to find out their stories.

name: Happy Birthday
summary: When his birthday is his sister's death day, on his 17th birthday they can connect with each other and she needs help from him to redemption and to apologize for what she did to her ex-boyfriend.

name: Lose Weight and Get Fit with Tom Kerridge
summary: Tom Kerridge recruits 11 like-minded volunteers to join him on a two-month weight loss and fitness challenge.

name: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
summary: After being injured and facing loss in the line of duty, retired Boston Police Detective Jeff Jackson returns to a quiet life of fishing, living in his late father's home on Martha's Vineyard. When a mysterious visitor to the island turns up dead, Jeff is reluctantly recruited to help in the investigation by the local police chief, a family friend.

previousepisode.name: Poisoned in Paradise: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery

name: Meet the Frasers
summary: Meet the Frasers follows Matt Fraser, a 28-year-old psychic medium, and his 21-year-old pageant queen girlfriend Alexa Papigiotis.  The two are highly visible local celebrities in their hometown of Cranston, Rhode Island. Matt and Alexa are envisioning big things for their future; Matt's captivating live reading events are growing more popular and his book "When Heaven Calls" will soon be published. And while Alexa supports Matt on his coast to coast tour, she's got big dreams of her own. She's setting her sights on winning her next pageant title and procuring a fabulous engagement ring. This couple is definitely on the rise - as long as their overly-involved families don't get in the way.

name: Cheer
summary: Cheer follows the ups and downs of Navarro College's competitive cheer squad as they work to win a coveted national title.

previousepisode.name: Daytona Pt. 2: If the Judges Disagree

name: Number 24
summary: Natsusa Yuzuki entered university expecting to be the rugby club's ace, but he can no longer play rugby due to certain circumstances. Ibuki Ueoka is a senior who also quit playing rugby. There is also Yasunari Tsuru, Natsusa's junior who finds him disagreeable. On the other hand, another junior, Yuu Mashiro looks up to Natsusa and follows in his footsteps. Last, there is Seiichirou Shingyouji, Natsusa's childhood best friend. This is an original rugby anime of former teammates who fight together in matches of Kansai's university rugby league.

previousepisode.name: You Can Do It! Japan Rugby!!!

name: Overflow
summary: "Brother, are we really taking a bath together?" And so, a forbidden bathing experience began. Me, my sister, and childhood friend—one man and two women—are sharing one bath. After involuntarily "overflowing," the sister's secret love come out?! This is a young romantic comedy that won't let you say, "it's over!"

name: Женщина без прошлого
summary: An elderly herbalist and a wealthy Greek, Theo, find a wounded girl in the forest. She has lost her memory and doesn't even know her name, so she is forced to re-acclimate herself in an unfamiliar world. Her past hides many secrets, and her present seems like a sad joke. Calling herself Alice, the heroine begins to pave the way to the truth and a lasting future. But old enemies and new acquaintances are not averse to taking advantage of the gaps in her memories.

name: The Last of the Mohicans
summary: Set during the French and Indian War, The Last of the Mohicans centers on the unlikely romance between Uncas, a young Mohican, and Cora, the mixed-race daughter of a British colonel.

name: Omniscient
summary: In a future where each citizen is monitored 24/7 by a drone, a woman discovers a murder unaccounted by this surveillance system, and investigates why.

previousepisode.name: Não esquece que eu estou de olho

name: Ariol
summary: Ariol provides young viewers with a relaxing and intimate moment of comedy. The series itemizes a number of aspects of modern life in a fun and offbeat way. Comic slices of life for 6 to 9 year-olds!

name: Baby Chimp Rescue
summary: Documentary following life in a home for orphaned chimpanzees run by wildlife vet Jimmy Desmond and his wife Jenny. The Desmonds started with just two rescued baby chimps, saved from the illegal pet trade, but now their home is bursting at the seams with 21 orphans to look after. Their dream is to build them all a new sanctuary in the forest and, with help from friend and chimp specialist Ben Garrod, they teach the orphans the skills they would have learnt from their mothers in the wild.

name: The All-Inclusive: How Do They Do It?
summary: Following groups of holiday makers as they embark on an all-inclusive week in the same resort - the Green family, the West family, and a group of friends from Crewe.

name: Getaways
summary: Travel series featuring holiday destinations abroad and closer to home.

name: The Scandals That Shocked Scotland
summary: Documentary series looking back at some of the scandals that have hit the headlines in Scotland in recent decades.

name: Monty Don's American Gardens
summary: Monty Don visits some of the most famous and interesting gardens in America.

name: Living on the Veg
summary:
Each week, vegan and internet chef sensations Henry Firth and Ian Theasby are joined by guests in the kitchen for their signature quick, delicious, fuss-free recipes with wow presentation. Cooking up pizzas, burgers, curries, pies, big breakfasts, decadent desserts – nothing is off the menu. They'll show you just how easy it is to recreate all your favourite meals without the meat and dairy. 

There's plant-based breakfasts, meat and dairy-free lunches, vegan dinners, plus a dessert or delicious but healthy snack. Each dish stands alone, or the whole menu can cut down on meal prep time for the week ahead.

name: Inside the Crown: Secrets of the Royals
summary:
Using rarely-seen footage and revealing historical documents, Inside the Crown: Secrets of the Royals tells the inside story of Queen's reign from the Coronation to the present.  

Historians, eyewitnesses, and royal insiders offer new insights on the pivotal moments in the Queen's life, with intriguing revelations about the real woman behind the Crown.

The series provides fresh insight from historians, biographers, royal insiders and the wider family along with eyewitnesses who all contribute to a new intimate portrait of the Queen and her family at key moments.

name: The Metro: A Rail Life Story
summary:
The Metro: A Rail Life Story follows life on the Tyne and Wear Metro – the first time cameras have been allowed in-depth behind the scenes at the UK's biggest metro system outside London.

The Metro is 48 miles long, with passengers making 37 million journeys a year around Newcastle, Sunderland, Gateshead, North and South Tyneside.

Filmed over the busy Summer of 2019 as the Metro approached its 40th birthday, cameras show some of its 1,100 staff dealing with the biggest events of the year – including the Great North Run and the Spice Girls reunion concert in Sunderland.

With 60 stations the Tyne and Wear Metro serves 100,000 passengers a day and its trains travel 10,000 miles a day. But, as the series reveals, it's a service that is often under fire and stretched to its limits as, ahead of a new fleet being delivered, it currently operates with trains that are as old as the Metro itself.

This series follows the highs and lows of the summer and provides a vivid insight into the daily trials and tribulations for staff.

name: Jeopardy! The Greatest of All Time
summary: This epic television event brings together the three highest money winners in the long-running game show's history. The fan favorites will compete in a series of matches; the first to win three receives $1 million and the title.

name: Detention
summary: At Benedict Arnold Middle School, there are a eight kids that are always mischievous and often wind up in detention: Shareena: The brain who's into reading and alternative culture. Emmitt: The one who's always looking for alien presence. Gug: The weird and fiesty boy. Jim: The obssessed comic fanatic. Duncan Bubble: The yo-yo wielding quiet boy. Orangejella and Lemonjella: Are twins who are geniuses that help their group try and succeed in their schemes. Shelley Kelly: A goody-goody girl. Miss Kisskillya: The insane teacher who manages to always catch these kids in their schemes.

name: Team Parate Eenheid
summary: The Team Ready Unit supports the police in all possible dangerous situations. A look behind the scenes at the men and women of the Rotterdam unit who must always be ready to intervene.

name: Celia
summary: The series, based on the stories of Elena Fortún, reflects the adventures of Celia, a seven-year-old girl belonging to Madrid's upper bourgeoisie at the beginning of the 20th century. Celia questions the identity of the Three Wise Men, she is surprised that grown-ups are so boring and follows a code of behavior that is far removed from that of adults, but also far removed from that of the children who share her adventures with her. Celia's spontaneity and determination won over audiences at the time and she became as popular a character as any television hero today.

name: Wrench'd
summary: Following the day-to-day work of the crew at Nichols Paint & Fab as they work on custom vehicles.

name: Bill Burr Presents: The Ringers
summary: Bill Burr Presents: The Ringers is an all-new stand-up series hosted, curated, and produced by legendary comedian Bill Burr and All Things Comedy. The series features "the best of the new best" comedians, with every episode spotlighting three performers. Each comedian is interviewed by Burr immediately before hitting the stage, opening up about their background and revealing the inspiration behind their comedic material.

previousepisode.name: Gavin Matts; Brenton Biddlecombe; Punkie Johnson

name: Next in Fashion
summary: Talented designers from around the world compete for $250,000 and the chance to become the next big thing in fashion.

name: Nekopara
summary: Despite being the proud owner of six catgirls alongside his sister Shigure, Kashou Minazuki moves away from home to open his patisserie La Soleil. While unpacking, he makes a startling discovery: two of his catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, have stowed away in his luggage! Although the twins desperately want to stay by their master's side, Kashou has no idea if he can manage both his new shop and the two catgirls. But what if having more hands on deck is exactly what he needs?

name: Hatena Illusion
summary: Ever since watching a magic show held by him and his wife Maeve, Makoto Shiranui has always admired Mamoru Hoshisato—a world-class magician, as well as friend of his parents—and came to Tokyo to become his apprentice. Kana, nicknamed Hatena, is the couple's daughter and his childhood friend. As the hustle and bustle activities in Tokyo catches Makoto off guard such as burglaries by a beautiful thief, he depends on Hatena's comforting side. When he came to Hoshisato's now-haunted mansion to reunite with his childhood friend, he is greeted by the family's butler and maid, Jeeves and Emma along with Hatena, only to discover that they are not as compatible anymore.

name: SVT CLUB
summary: SVT Club is a blend of a talk show and a reality show where Seventeen discusses and shares their thoughts and experiences on a certain key word revealed at the start of each episode by MC Kim Hwan, who also guides their talks. In between various discussions, videos of the boys exploring something related to the topic is also played.

name: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun
summary: At Kamome Academy, rumors abound about the school's Seven Mysteries, one of which is Hanako-san. Said to occupy the third stall of the third floor girls' bathroom in the old school building, Hanako-san grants any wish when summoned. Nene Yashiro, an occult-loving high school girl who dreams of romance, ventures into this haunted bathroom...but the Hanako-san she meets there is nothing like she imagined! Kamome Academy's Hanako-san...is a boy!

name: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
summary: New Show by Rock!! TV Series featuring the new band Mashumairesh!!

name: Uchitama?! Have You Seen My Tama?
summary: In a city somewhere in Japan, there's a flyer often seen on Third Street with a picture of a cat with a kinked tail, bearing the words: "Have you seen Tama?" A young boy gazes at the flyer, but he has fluffy ears on his head…!? Watch the dogs and cats from Third Street take on a human form and get up to some mischief.

previousepisode.name: Tama's True Identity / Cat Meeting / My Treasure

name: Wild Castles
summary: Europe's abandoned castles are magnificent markers of the continent's tempestuous history. But where they once hosted royalty, these empty, hulking structures have now been overtaken by the wildlife and rich natural environments flourishing around them. From peregrine falcons ruling the bell towers of Germany's Heidelberg Castle to exotic amphibians thriving in the spring-fed fountains of Spain's iconic Alhambra palace, explore the curious history of these imposing European structures and meet the creatures that call them home.
